product-styling + rapid-styling

Both guide every styling change in the same existing product. One prohibits adding frameworks; the other mandates installing AuroraCSS, even when a framework already exists.

Recommendation
Keep the current product constraint. Before adopting rapid-styling, scope it to explicit migrations or projects that permit AuroraCSS, or revise its mandatory installation rule. Do not compose these unchanged for one styling task.

Preserve
Preserves the existing dependency boundary and retains a possible AuroraCSS workflow for an appropriate context. No skill was installed or modified.

button-consistency + button-polish

Both apply to button edits in the same product. Their required references mandate incompatible radii: 8px for every state and 24px for every button.

Recommendation
Select the authoritative product contract before applying either radius. Align the references or define an approved migration exception; the supplied material does not establish which rule should win.

Preserve
Preserves consistent button styling while avoiding an unsupported decision to replace the existing contract. No buttons or skill files were edited.

interface-builder + accessibility-review

A component is implemented from a brief, then the resulting interface is inspected for accessibility barriers. Shared accessibility vocabulary does not make implementation and audit redundant.

Recommendation
Keep both. Use the builder for implementation and the reviewer for evidence-based auditing; sequence both when the user requests creation and review. Do not remove one on an unmeasured token-savings claim.

Preserve
Retains implementation using existing design tokens and the separate barrier report with proposed remedies. Removing either loses a distinct phase.

Source evidence · 2 spans

interface-builder / SKILL.md:8–8

Build the requested components using the existing design tokens. Ensure semantic markup and keyboard operation. Leave a summary of implemented components.

accessibility-review / SKILL.md:8–8

Inspect the existing interface and keyboard flow. Report barriers with evidence and proposed remedies. Do not implement visual redesigns during an audit.
